Lua 5.4.8, vendored for the add-on script runtime (docs/design/25 §9 A, PR 57)
==========================================================================

Source   https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.8.tar.gz
SHA-512  875ad1f6df3ba63722b5069564c9d3a4057b4c3564c691061bb49cf6cdf5d2e303f05762bd46797b444aaf992c03021f423df142123eebf86751fd77edaf8060
         (the hash vcpkg's lua 5.4.8 port pins)
Licence  MIT (LICENSE, from the foot of lua.h). Linked statically; THIRD-PARTY.md.

Why vendored and not vcpkg (docs/design/12, 2026-10-11): the pinned vcpkg baseline
ships Lua 5.5, the Windows triplet links ports dynamically, and the sandbox wants
the io / os / package / debug libraries absent from the binary, not merely
unreachable. Built by CMake as C++ (a Lua error is a C++ exception, so the
runtime's RAII holds across one), with the project's warnings off: it is not
our code. No JIT exists in Lua, so the Mac's hardened runtime needs no exception.

What is here: src/ of the release, minus
  lua.c luac.c          the stand-alone interpreter and compiler
  liolib.c loslib.c     io, os
  loadlib.c ldblib.c    package / require, debug
  linit.c               luaL_openlibs (the runtime opens its own subset)

Local changes, all marked "MediaViewer" (diff against the tarball to see them):
  src/mv_interrupt.h    new: mv_lua_check_interrupt(), the watchdog's flag
  src/lstrlib.c         match() checks the flag on entry (pattern backtracking
                        runs no VM instruction, so the count hook never fires);
                        string.rep returns "" at once when the piece and the
                        separator are both empty (it looped n times copying nothing)
  src/ltablib.c         table.move and table.sort check the flag per step
  src/lgc.c             luaC_checkfinalizer marks nothing: no __gc ever runs (GCTM
                        runs a finalizer with hooks off, so a looping one could
                        not be stopped, during a task or at lua_close);
                        traversetable ignores __mode: no weak tables (ephemeron
                        convergence is quadratic inside one atomic GC step)

To update: replace src/ from a new 5.4.x tarball, drop the files above, re-apply
the marked changes, update this file and the hash, then run mv_script_tests and
the fuzz_script harness.
